subject: Steering committee / exec sponsor scheduling & prep for FinIntegrate
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Steering committee / exec sponsor scheduling & prep for FinIntegrate

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. As discussed, the next step to move this forward is a 30–45 minute steering committee meeting with your exec sponsor and the key stakeholders from security/procurement/finance so we can cover:

- Business objectives and decision criteria (what success looks like)
- Security/compliance checklist and evidence expectations (SOC2, retention, audit logs)
- Procurement/timescale and contract owner
- Proposed rollout and pilot success metrics

Proposed dates/times (PST):
- Tue 2027-03-08, 9:00–9:45am
- Wed 2027-03-09, 11:00–11:45am
- Thu 2027-03-10, 2:00–2:45pm

Can you confirm who from FinIntegrate you want to invite (economic buyer / exec sponsor + security / procurement / product lead)? I attached a short steering deck that we can present and our discovery notes for reference. Rafael will join from our solutions team; Vivek (CTO) has offered to join if helpful for exec-level discussion.

Attachments: redwood-steering-deck.pdf, discovery-notes-20270301.txt

Thanks — happy to adjust timing to match your exec’s calendar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Mobile: (415) 555-0147

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@fintegrate.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@fintegrate.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@fintegrate.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Steering committee / exec sponsor scheduling & prep for FinIntegrate

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the deck. All three proposed slots mostly work — prefer Wed 2027-03-09 at 11:00 PT. I’ll invite the following:
- Elena Park (CIO) — exec sponsor / economic buyer
- Marcus Lin (Head of Procurement) — procurement/contact for contracting
- Priya Natarajan (Head of InfoSec) — security & compliance

We’d also like to include our product lead (Tommy Alvarez is the exec sponsor; I’ll confirm if product should join after checking with Elena).

Quick question on pre-read: can you include a brief SOC 2 summary and a short bullets-only risks/controls page so our security team can triage before the call? If you can get that by EOD Tuesday, we’ll circulate internally.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 2027-03-09 11:00 PT and update the attendee list.

Best,
Tom
VP of Partnerships
FinIntegrate
Tom.Alvarez@fintegrate.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 9:12 AM Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintegrate.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the recap and the deck. All three proposed slots mostly work — prefer Wed 2027-03-09 at 11:00 PT.

Thanks Tom — 11:00 PT works for me. I’ll prepare a 5–7 minute operations/architecture slide to cover throughput, latency SLOs, and our recommended pilot sizing. Also we’ll include a short appendix on network topology and data handling.

Marissa — can you confirm whether FinIntegrate needs an NDA or additional contract terms up front? If Marcus will own procurement, I can coordinate a simple statement of work after we align on pilot scope.

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Rafael —

Quick ask from my side: Priya’s team will likely want a succinct security artifacts list (SOC 2, data residency, audit logs retention, KMS/HSM options, and any third-party subprocessors). Can we produce a one-page summary (bullets) plus the SOC 2 summary Tom requested? Stephanie — can you own pulling the SOC 2 cover letter + the one-page controls summary and drop in the Drive link so Marissa can share as pre-read?

I’ll plan to join the steering committee unless schedules conflict. Rafael, please include an appendix slide on RBAC and encryption-at-rest for quick triage.

- Elena Park (CIO / exec sponsor) — FinIntegrate
